notes: TITLE INCORRECT (research 2026-07-03): this tree calls him the "9th Earl of Crawford," but the real, documented 9th Earl of Crawford (David Lindsay of Edzell, "the Interpolated Earl") inherited the earldom in 1542 and died in 1558 — nearly 80 years before this record's 1636 birth date (Wikipedia; FamilySearch L5ZW-QTL; WikiTree Lindsay-484; thepeerage.com). This 1636-1698 David Lindsay of Edzell appears to be a real, later member of the Lindsay-of-Edzell family, but the "9th Earl" title attached to him is a documented mix-up between two different people who share a name and place. His marriage to Jeane Innesse (I182381537276) and paternity of Helene Lindsay (I182381537266) could not be independently confirmed in this pass — treat as legend-grade pending a proper peerage source.
